Design

DES-0001 Closed-loop amplitude control algorithm

TitleClosed-loop amplitude control algorithm
Statusapproved
ImplementsREQ-0001, REQ-0002
Standards
  • IEC 60601-1
  • IEC 62304
  • ISO 14708-3
Order1
MitigatesRSK-0001

Description

A control loop running on the implant's microcontroller that reads the evoked compound action potential (ECAP) amplitude from the sense electrode once per stimulation cycle and adjusts the delivered pulse amplitude to hold the ECAP response within a clinician-configured target band, subject to the hardware current-limit described in REQ-0003.

Each cycle moves the amplitude toward the target band by a fixed fraction of the error, as Equation 1 states, then clamps it to the ceiling:
